name: Icewind Dale Complete
description: Icewind Dale Complete is a singleplayer and multiplayer isometric role-playing game, bundling Icewind Dale, the first game in the Icewind Dale series, with its Heart of Winter expansion.

gog.store_details: This is the original 2000 Icewind Dale with its Heart of Winter and Trials of the Luremaster expansions, not 2014's 'Enhanced Edition'. GOG had stopped selling it by November 2016 (per GOG's forums), but it's still an ideal candidate for restoring EAX sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Icewind Dale turns on 'Environmental Audio' by itself the first time it starts.

sources.title: GOG forum: BGEE, BG2EE, IWEE vs originals
